decisions.label: Pack combat
decisions.note: Home's ten kinds fight in packs (docs/backlog/combat.md build step 1; Ed, 2026-10-19): every member glows before a combo, the nearest lunges, the ones at range fire where a dodge would go, the one behind her throws its kind's special, then they fall back by their kind's retreat and come again; her own pack combos without retreating. Off as built; on by default since 2026-10-20 (Ed: "Turn pack combat on by default"), the toggle kept to turn it off for testing. Live: try it with ?arena=pack-fox (any home kind) or ?arena=hers-fox.
